scope: Prevent Directus dashboard dataset queries from using archived query_sql as an information side channel.

blocked_query_uses: Nested or qualified filter predicates on query_sql
Sort and group-by references to query_sql
Broad collection search while archived query_sql remains stored
behavior.denial: Generic FORBIDDEN / HTTP 403 before collection data queries
preserved: Ordinary metadata filters, projections, and sorting
Wildcard/default projections with query_sql removed from response payloads

remaining_gates: Effective deployed Directus field and role permissions for all fields
Populated dashboard parity and external consumer authorization
